Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Bulbul Das
Message:
feat: deploy Frappe CRM on local Kubernetes cluster using Minikube

- Add Kubernetes manifests for namespace, configmaps, secrets template, and storage
- Add MariaDB StatefulSet with 10Gi persistent volume claim
- Add Redis Deployment for in-memory cache, background queues, and WebSocket pub/sub
- Add Frappe CRM Deployment with initContainers for volume permissions and site provisioning
- Add NodePort Service exposing web (port 8000) and WebSocket (port 9000)
- Add comprehensive README with architecture diagram, verification commands, and troubleshooting guide
